internal readonly struct AdsPropertyInfo : IComparable<AdsPropertyInfo>
{
	internal static readonly AdsPropertyInfo Empty = new AdsPropertyInfo(int.MaxValue, string.Empty, string.Empty);

	internal readonly string PropertyName;

	internal readonly int DisplayOrder;

	internal readonly string LocalizedValue;

	internal AdsPropertyInfo(int displayOrder, string propertyName, string localizedValue)
	{
		DisplayOrder = displayOrder;
		PropertyName = propertyName;
		LocalizedValue = localizedValue;
	}

	public static bool operator ==(AdsPropertyInfo propertyData, string value)
	{
		return propertyData.Equals(value);
	}

	public static bool operator ==(string value, AdsPropertyInfo propertyData)
	{
		return propertyData.Equals(value);
	}

	public static bool operator !=(AdsPropertyInfo propertyData, string value)
	{
		return !propertyData.Equals(value);
	}

	public static bool operator !=(string value, AdsPropertyInfo propertyData)
	{
		return !propertyData.Equals(value);
	}

	public static bool operator ==(AdsPropertyInfo data1, AdsPropertyInfo data2)
	{
		return data1.Equals(data2);
	}

	public static bool operator !=(AdsPropertyInfo data1, AdsPropertyInfo data2)
	{
		return !data1.Equals(data2);
	}

	public override bool Equals(object obj)
	{
		if (obj is AdsPropertyInfo adsPropertyInfo)
		{
			if (DisplayOrder == adsPropertyInfo.DisplayOrder)
			{
				return adsPropertyInfo == PropertyName;
			}
			return false;
		}
		if (obj is string b)
		{
			return string.Equals(PropertyName, b, StringComparison.Ordinal);
		}
		return base.Equals(obj);
	}

	public override int GetHashCode()
	{
		return DisplayOrder;
	}

	public int CompareTo(AdsPropertyInfo other)
	{
		return DisplayOrder.CompareTo(other.DisplayOrder);
	}
}

		};

		public static double convertValueFromTo(double value, int category, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			if (category >= UnitsTable.Count)
			{
				return value;
			}
			Tuple<double, double> tuple = UnitsTable?[category - 1][fromUnit];
			Tuple<double, double> tuple2 = UnitsTable?[category - 1][toUnit];
			if (tuple == null || tuple2 == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return (value * tuple.Item1 + tuple.Item2 - tuple2.Item2) / tuple2.Item1;
		}
	}

			object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)(((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRStoic_Result_Reac))?.FindName("calculatedHeatReacColumn");

			OnCalculationTypeChanged();
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void cmdBrowse_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			AesXamValueEditBrowse val = (AesXamValueEditBrowse)((parameter is AesXamValueEditBrowse) ? parameter : null);
			OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			if (val.Value != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.Value.ToString()))
			{
				openFileDialog.FileName = val.Value.ToString();
			}
			if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog().Value)
			{
				val.Value = openFileDialog.FileName;
			}
		}

		private bool HasCustomReactionsResults
		{
			get
			{
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.columnCustom", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (!val.success)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (val.value != null && val.value.ToString().Trim() == "1")
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasComponentRatesResults
		{
			get
			{
				string path = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.SSCompGenerateRates";
				return HaveResults(path);
			}
		}

		private bool HasReactionRatesResults
		{
			get
			{
				string path = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates";
				return HaveResults(path);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			SetTabAccessible();
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunCompleted()
		{
			SetTabAccessible();
			base.OnSimulationRunCompleted();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep()
		{
			SetTabAccessible();
			base.OnSimulationIntegrationStep();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunFailed()
		{
			SetTabAccessible();
			base.OnSimulationRunFailed();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationReinitialized()
		{
			DisEnableTab();
			base.OnSimulationReinitialized();
		}

		private bool HaveResults(string path)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, path, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			MMRPlug_Profil v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRPlug_Profil;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.MMTabItem_CustomReactions.Accessible = HasCustomReactionsResults;
					v.MMTabItem_ComponentRates.Accessible = HasComponentRatesResults;
					v.MMTabItem_ReactionRates.Accessible = HasReactionRatesResults;
				});
			}
		}

		private void DisEnableTab()
		{
			MMRPlug_Profil v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRPlug_Profil;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.MMTabItem_CustomReactions.Accessible = false;
					v.MMTabItem_ComponentRates.Accessible = false;
					v.MMTabItem_ReactionRates.Accessible = false;
				});
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ComponentColumnHeaderConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string[] array = text.Split(' ');
				if (array != null && array.Length == 3 && string.Equals(array[1], array[2], StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return array[0] + " " + array[1];
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		private bool HasCustomReactionsResults
		{
			get
			{
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.columnCustom", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (!val.success)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (val.value != null && val.value.ToString().Trim() == "1")
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasComponentRatesResults
		{
			get
			{
				string path = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.SSCompGenerateRates";
				return HaveResults(path);
			}
		}

		private bool HasReactionRatesResults
		{
			get
			{
				string path = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.ProfileKinetics.#0.ReactionSetRates";
				return HaveResults(path);
			}
		}

		private bool HaveResults(string path)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, path, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			MMRBatch_Profil v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRBatch_Profil;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.MMTabItem_CustomReactions.Accessible = HasCustomReactionsResults;
					v.MMTabItem_ComponentRates.Accessible = HasComponentRatesResults;
					v.MMTabItem_ReactionRates.Accessible = HasReactionRatesResults;
				});
			}
		}

		private void DisEnableTab()
		{
			MMRBatch_Profil v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRBatch_Profil;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.MMTabItem_CustomReactions.Accessible = false;
					v.MMTabItem_ComponentRates.Accessible = false;
					v.MMTabItem_ReactionRates.Accessible = false;
				});
			}
		}

				CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((advCboView_AdvCollection is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? advCboView_AdvCollection : null);

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "_AdvCboView_sel_view" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				object advCboView_AdvCollection = AdvCboView_AdvCollection;
				CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((advCboView_AdvCollection is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? advCboView_AdvCollection : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (val.SelectedItem == "Reactor" || val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMRBatch_Profil_Overal_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Reactor)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("indvar", (object)"TIME");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamReactorVisible", (object)"1");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentAccVisible", (object)"0");
					}
					else if (val.SelectedItem == "Vent" || val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMRBatch_Profil_Overal_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Vent)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("indvar", (object)"TIME_VEAC");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamReactorVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentVisible", (object)"1");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentAccVisible", (object)"0");
					}
					else if (val.SelectedItem == "Vent accumulator" || val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMRBatch_Profil_Overal_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Vent_accumulator)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("indvar", (object)"TIME_VEAC");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamReactorVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamVentAccVisible", (object)"1");
					}
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

namespace AspenTech.AspenPlus.MMForms.Blocks.Reactor.Images
{
	internal static class IconHelper
	{
		[DllImport("gdi32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern bool DeleteObject(IntPtr hObject);

		public static ImageSource ToImageSource(this Icon icon)
		{
			IntPtr hbitmap = icon.ToBitmap().GetHbitmap();
			ImageSource result = Imaging.CreateBitmapSourceFromHBitmap(hbitmap, IntPtr.Zero, Int32Rect.Empty, BitmapSizeOptions.FromEmptyOptions());
			if (!DeleteObject(hbitmap))
			{
				throw new Win32Exception();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal static class ImageResources
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, ImageSource> _imageSources = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_All => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-full.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_NoHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-full-3.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_InletHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-full-2.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_OutletHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-full-1.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-NoStackInlet.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds_NoHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-NoStackInlet-3.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds_InletHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-NoStackInlet-2.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds_OutletHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-NoStackInlet-1.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-1feed_full.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed_NoHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-1Feed_3.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed_InletHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-1Feed_2.png");

		public static ImageSource ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed_OutletHeat => GetImageSource("electrolyzer-stack-1Feed_1.png");

		private static ImageSource GetImageSource(string imageFileName)
		{
			if (!_imageSources.ContainsKey(imageFileName))
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append("pack://application:,,,/");
				stringBuilder.Append(typeof(ImageResources).Assembly.FullName);
				stringBuilder.Append(";component/Images/");
				stringBuilder.Append(imageFileName);
				_imageSources.Add(imageFileName, new BitmapImage(new Uri(stringBuilder.ToString(), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute)));
			}
			return _imageSources[imageFileName];
		}

		private static ImageSource GetImageSource(string imageFileName, int width, int height)
		{
			string key = imageFileName + width;
			if (!_imageSources.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append("pack://application:,,,/");
				stringBuilder.Append(typeof(ImageResources).Assembly.FullName);
				stringBuilder.Append(";component/Images/");
				stringBuilder.Append(imageFileName);
				Icon icon = new Icon(Application.GetResourceStream(new Uri(stringBuilder.ToString())).Stream, new System.Drawing.Size(width, height));
				_imageSources.Add(key, icon.ToImageSource());
			}
			return _imageSources[key];
		}
	}

					voltage = value;
					int num = 0;
					decimal num2 = (decimal)voltage - (decimal)(int)voltage;
					if (num2 != 0m)
					{
						num = num2.ToString().Length - 2;
					}
					VoltageStr = value.ToString("N" + num);
				}
			}

			public double density { get; set; }

			public double Density
			{
				get
				{
					return density;
				}
				set
				{
					density = value;
					int num = 0;
					decimal num2 = (decimal)density - (decimal)(int)density;
					if (num2 != 0m)
					{
						num = num2.ToString().Length - 2;
					}
					DensityStr = value.ToString("N" + num);
				}
			}

			public string VoltageStr { get; set; }

			public string DensityStr { get; set; }
		}

		}

		private void OnDeleteCurveCondtion(object pParameter)
		{
			List<string> list = ((pParameter != null) ? new Collection<string> { pParameter as string }.ToList() : GetSelectedIds().ToList());
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@reftemp", "child_ids")) != null && list != null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).NotifyUpdates = false;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.SuspendNotifications();
				DeleteCurveCondtionChildren(list, askForConfirmation: true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).NotifyUpdates = true;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.ResumeNotifications();
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = CurveCondition_GridData as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				CurveCondition_GridData_ItemTemplate curveCondition_GridData_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as CurveCondition_GridData_ItemTemplate;
				yield return curveCondition_GridData_ItemTemplate.GetId();
			}
		}

		private void DeleteCurveCondtionChildren(IEnumerable<string> ids, bool askForConfirmation = false)
		{
			Collection<string> source = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@reftemp", "child_ids"));
			IList<string> deletedIds = ((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.@reftemp"), ids, !askForConfirmation);
			if (deletedIds == null || deletedIds.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.@voltage"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			List<string> list = (from r in source
				select (r) into a
				where !deletedIds.Contains(a)
				select a).ToList();
			for (int num = 1; num <= list.Count; num++)
			{
				string text = list[num - 1];
				if (text != num.ToString())
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.@reftemp." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.@voltage." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
				}
			}
			int num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@ncurves", "value")) ?? 0;
			num2 -= deletedIds.Count;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.@ncurves", "value", (object)num2);
			}
			else
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.@ncurves", "value", (object)null);
			}
		}

		private bool OnDeleteCurvePointCanExecute(object arg)
		{
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo", "child_ids"));
			if (collection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
				{
					if (collection[i].Contains("#"))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnDeleteCurvePoint(object pst_Parameter)
		{
			List<string> list = ((pst_Parameter != null) ? new Collection<string> { pst_Parameter as string }.ToList() : GetPointSelectedIds().ToList());
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo", "child_ids"));
			IList<string> deletedIds = ((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo"), (IEnumerable<string>)list, false);
			if (collection == null || list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> list2 = (from r in CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo", "child_ids"))
				select (r) into a
				where !deletedIds.Contains(a)
				select a).ToList();
			int num = 0;
			for (int num2 = 1; num2 <= list2.Count; num2++)
			{
				string text = list2[num2 - 1];
				if (text != num2.ToString() || num == 1)
				{
					num = 1;
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo." + text, "id", (object)num2.ToString());
				}
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
		}

		private void updatePlotCurve()
		{
			_ = showPlotsChecked;
			int num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@ncurves", "value")) ?? 0;
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CURVE_TYPE", "value"));
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<PlotCurves> list2 = new List<PlotCurves>();
			List<string> list3 = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 1; i < num + 1; i++)
			{
				int num2 = 1;
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@active." + i, "value")) == "YES")
				{
					list.Add(i);
					Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage." + i + "@p_CurveNo.", "child_ids"));
					if (collection == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < collection.Count; j++)
					{
						if ((CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@condens." + i + "." + num2, "value")) ?? (-1.0)) != -1.0 && (CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage." + i + "." + num2, "value")) ?? (-1.0)) != -1.0)
						{
							PlotCurves plotCurves = new PlotCurves();
							plotCurves.CurveNum = i;
							plotCurves.Voltage = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage." + i + "." + num2, "value")).GetValueOrDefault();
							plotCurves.Density = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@condens." + i + "." + num2, "value")).GetValueOrDefault();
							list2.Add(plotCurves);
						}
						num2++;
					}
				}
				string item = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@descrip." + i, "value"));
				list3.Add(item);
			}
			list2 = (from x in list2
				orderby x.Density descending, x.CurveNum
				select x).ToList();
			object nCurves_var = NCurves_var;
			string selectedItem = ((CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((nCurves_var is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? nCurves_var : null)).SelectedItem;
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main") });
			string oprPntUnits = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.OperatingCurrentDensity", "uom"));
			string oprPntUnits2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VoltageStack", "uom"));
			string oprPntUnits3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VoltageCell", "uom"));
			double density = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.OperatingCurrentDensity", "value")).GetValueOrDefault();
			double voltage = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VoltageStack", "value")).GetValueOrDefault();
			double voltage2 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VoltageCell", "value")).GetValueOrDefault();
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.OperatingCurrentDensity", "value") == null)
			{
				voltage2 = 0.0;
				density = 0.0;
				voltage = 0.0;
			}
			else if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VoltageCell", "value") == null)
			{
				voltage2 = 0.0;
			}
			else if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VoltageStack", "value") == null)
			{
				voltage = 0.0;
			}
			PlotCurves plotCurves2 = new PlotCurves();
			List<PlotCurves> list4 = new List<PlotCurves>();
			string yAxisTitle = "";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage." + selectedItem + ".1", "uom"));
			string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@condens." + selectedItem + ".1", "uom"));
			if (text == "STCKV-CRDNS")
			{
				plotCurves2.Voltage = voltage;
				plotCurves2.Density = density;
				yAxisTitle = ApwnResources.MMElectrolyzer_PerformanceCurves_YAxisTitle_SV + " (" + text2 + ")";
				plotCurves2.Voltage = getUnitConversion("VOLTAGE", oprPntUnits2, text2, plotCurves2.Voltage);
			}
			else if (text == "CELLV-CRDNS")
			{
				plotCurves2.Voltage = voltage2;
				plotCurves2.Density = density;
				yAxisTitle = ApwnResources.MMElectrolyzer_PerformanceCurves_YAxisTitle_CV + " (" + text2 + ")";
				plotCurves2.Voltage = getUnitConversion("VOLTAGE", oprPntUnits3, text2, plotCurves2.Voltage);
			}
			plotCurves2.Density = getUnitConversion("CURRENT-DENS", oprPntUnits, text3, plotCurves2.Density);
			list4.Add(plotCurves2);
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMElectrolyzer_PerformanceCurves_Setup mMElectrolyzer_PerformanceCurves_Setup)
			{
				mMElectrolyzer_PerformanceCurves_Setup.set_PlotCurves(list2, num, list, yAxisTitle, text3, list3, list4, showPlotsChecked);
				if (addCommandSet)
				{
					mMElectrolyzer_PerformanceCurves_Setup.set_SelectedValue(num);
					addCommandSet = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private double getUnitConversion(string unitRowName, string oprPntUnits, string plotUnits, double oprPntValue)
		{
			double result = oprPntValue;
			if (oprPntUnits != plotUnits)
			{
				HelperFuncs.ConvertValue(HelperFuncs.Fnduntrow(unitRowName), oprPntValue, oprPntUnits, plotUnits, ref result);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			setPlotVisibility();
			updatePlotCurve();
		}

		private void setPlotVisibility()
		{
			if ("NO" == CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SHOW_PLOTS", "value")))
			{
				ShowPlotVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_showPlotsChecked = false;
				dontCallSetVisibility = true;
				showPlotsChecked = false;
			}
			else if ("YES" == CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SHOW_PLOTS", "value")))
			{
				ShowPlotVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				_showPlotsChecked = true;
				dontCallSetVisibility = true;
				showPlotsChecked = true;
			}
			dontCallSetVisibility = false;
		}

		private void setVisbility()
		{
			if (ShowPlotVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				ShowPlotVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SHOW_PLOTS", "value", (object)"NO");
			}
			else if (ShowPlotVisibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				ShowPlotVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SHOW_PLOTS", "value", (object)"YES");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd == NCurves_var_Property && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				updatePlotCurve();
			}
		}

		private void updateCurveUnit()
		{
			int num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@ncurves", "value")) ?? 0;
			if (num < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = "@main.Input.@condens.#";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@densityunit", "uom"));
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text + i + ".#0", "uom"));
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text + i, "child_ids"));
				if (text2 != text3 && array != null)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text + i + ".#0", "uom", (object)text2);
				}
			}
			string text4 = "@main.Input.@voltage.#";
			string text5 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltageunit", "uom"));
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				string text6 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text4 + j + ".#0", "uom"));
				string[] array2 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text4 + j, "child_ids"));
				if (text5 != text6 && array2 != null)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text4 + j + ".#0", "uom", (object)text5);
				}
			}
		}

		private void updateCurvePoint()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IList list = DVCurve_GridData as IList;
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo", "child_ids"));
			if (collection == null || list.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (collection[i].Contains("#"))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				string text = "@main.Input.@voltage.@p_CurveNo.#";
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
				{
					string text2 = text + (num - 1);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text2, "id", (object)num.ToString());
				}
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{

					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("cc", (object)"GENSV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("reftemp", (object)"SV_REF_TEMP");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("refpres", (object)"SV_REF_PRES");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("descrip", (object)"SV_CURVEDESC");

				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("voltage", (object)"CV_VOLTG");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("condens", (object)"CV_CRDN");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("densityunit", (object)"CV_CRDN_UNIT");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("voltageunit", (object)"CV_VOLT_UNIT");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("cc", (object)"GENCV");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("reftemp", (object)"CV_REF_TEMP");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("refpres", (object)"CV_REF_PRES");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("descrip", (object)"CV_CURVEDESC");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("active", (object)"CV_ACTIVECUR");
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			updateCurvePoint();
			setPlotVisibility();
			updateCurveUnit();
			updatePlotCurve();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider != null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.Message += Case_Message;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("_pView", (object)"Electrolyzer assembly");

		}

		public override void OnViewClosed()
		{

			}
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewClosed();
		}

		private void Case_Message(object sender, CxsMessageEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			foreach (CxsMessage message in e.Messages)
			{
				CxsMessage current = message;
				if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 5)
				{
					object view = ((MMViewModel)this).View;
					((DispatcherObject)((view is MMTabPage) ? view : null)).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						string filter = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("view_var1.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
						SetFilter(filter);
					}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if ((pd.Name == "view_var1" || pd.Name == "IsStack") && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				string filter = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("view_var1.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				SetFilter(filter);
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void SetFilter(string view)
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMElectrolyzer_Result_Summary mMElectrolyzer_Result_Summary))
			{
				return;
			}
			MMScrollAreaManualLayout summaryGrid = mMElectrolyzer_Result_Summary.summaryGrid;
			string text = "all";
			switch (view)
			{
			case "Electrolyzer assembly":
				text = "assembly";
				break;
			case "Stack":
				text = "stack";
				break;
			case "Cell":
				text = "cell";
				break;
			}
			bool flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("IsStack.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null)) ?? false;
			bool flag2 = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("IsCorrelation.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null)) ?? false;
			bool flag3 = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("IsRigorous.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null)) ?? false;
			foreach (MMScrollAreaRecord item in (Collection<MMScrollAreaRecord>)(object)summaryGrid.MMRecords)
			{
				if (text == "all")
				{
					item.IsVisible = true;
				}
				else if (item.Name.StartsWith(text))
				{
					item.IsVisible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					item.IsVisible = false;
				}
				if (item.IsVisible && (item.Name == "cell_waterCrossMem" || item.Name == "cell_H2CrossMem") && !flag)
				{
					item.IsVisible = false;
				}
				if (item.IsVisible && (!flag3 || (!flag2 && flag3)) && (item.Name == "assembly_AnodeBubDia" || item.Name == "assembly_CathodeBubDia"))
				{
					item.IsVisible = false;
				}
				if (item.IsVisible && !flag3 && (item.Name == "assembly21" || item.Name == "assembly28" || item.Name == "assembly29" || item.Name == "assembly30"))
				{
					item.IsVisible = false;
				}
				if (item.IsVisible && item.Name == "assembly_CurrentDensity")
				{
					object currentDensityAssembly = CurrentDensityAssembly;
					CxvVariableData val = (CxvVariableData)((currentDensityAssembly is CxvVariableData) ? currentDensityAssembly : null);
					if (val != null && ((CxvStatePropertyData)val).IsVisible == true && val.Value != null)
					{
						item.IsVisible = true;
					}
					else
					{
						item.IsVisible = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main") });
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

			PowerInletStream = null;
			AnodeOutletStream = null;
			CathodInletStream = null;
			HeatInletStream = null;
			CathodeOutletStream = null;
			HeatOutletStream = null;
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.FA(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection2 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.FS(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection3 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.FC(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection4 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.HS(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection5 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.PS(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection6 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.PA(OUT)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection7 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.PC(OUT)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection8 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.HS(OUT)", "child_ids"));
			if (collection != null && collection.Count > 0)
			{
				AnodeInletStream = collection[0];
			}
			if (collection2 != null && collection2.Count > 0)
			{
				StackInletStream = collection2[0];
			}
			if (collection5 != null && collection5.Count > 0)
			{
				PowerInletStream = collection5[0];
			}
			if (collection6 != null && collection6.Count > 0)
			{
				AnodeOutletStream = collection6[0];
			}
			if (collection3 != null && collection3.Count > 0)
			{
				CathodInletStream = collection3[0];
			}
			if (collection4 != null && collection4.Count > 0)
			{
				HeatInletStream = collection4[0];
			}
			if (collection7 != null && collection7.Count > 0)
			{
				CathodeOutletStream = collection7[0];
			}
			if (collection8 != null && collection8.Count > 0)
			{
				HeatOutletStream = collection8[0];
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

	internal class InverseBooleanToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return ((bool)value) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			AnodeInletStream = null;
			StackInletStream = null;
			PowerInletStream = null;
			AnodeOutletStream = null;
			CathodInletStream = null;
			HeatInletStream = null;
			CathodeOutletStream = null;
			HeatOutletStream = null;
			HasAnodeInlet = false;
			HasAnodeOutlet = false;
			HasCathodeInlet = false;
			HasCathodeOutlet = false;
			HasHeatInlet = false;
			HasHeatOutlet = false;
			HasPower = false;
			HasStackInlet = false;
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.FA(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection2 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.FS(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection3 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.FC(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection4 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.HS(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection5 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.PS(IN)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection6 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.PA(OUT)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection7 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.PC(OUT)", "child_ids"));
			Collection<string> collection8 = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Ports.HS(OUT)", "child_ids"));
			if (collection != null && collection.Count > 0)
			{
				AnodeInletStream = collection[0];
				HasAnodeInlet = true;
			}
			if (collection2 != null && collection2.Count > 0)
			{
				StackInletStream = collection2[0];
				HasStackInlet = true;
			}
			if (collection5 != null && collection5.Count > 0)
			{
				PowerInletStream = collection5[0];
				HasPower = true;
			}
			if (collection6 != null && collection6.Count > 0)
			{
				AnodeOutletStream = collection6[0];
				HasAnodeOutlet = true;
			}
			if (collection3 != null && collection3.Count > 0)
			{
				CathodInletStream = collection3[0];
				HasCathodeInlet = true;
			}
			if (collection4 != null && collection4.Count > 0)
			{
				HeatInletStream = collection4[0];
				HasHeatInlet = true;
			}
			if (collection7 != null && collection7.Count > 0)
			{
				CathodeOutletStream = collection7[0];
				HasCathodeOutlet = true;
			}
			if (collection8 != null && collection8.Count > 0)
			{
				HeatOutletStream = collection8[0];
				HasHeatOutlet = true;
			}
			if (StackInletStream != null)
			{
				if (CathodInletStream != null || AnodeInletStream != null)
				{
					if (HeatInletStream != null)
					{
						if (HeatOutletStream != null)
						{
							ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_All;
						}
						else
						{
							ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_InletHeat;
						}
					}
					else if (HeatOutletStream != null)
					{
						ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_OutletHeat;
					}
					else
					{
						ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_NoHeat;
					}
				}
				else if (HeatInletStream != null)
				{
					if (HeatOutletStream != null)
					{
						ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed;
					}
					else
					{
						ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed_InletHeat;
					}
				}
				else if (HeatOutletStream != null)
				{
					ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed_OutletHeat;
				}
				else
				{
					ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_1Feed_NoHeat;
				}
			}
			else if (HeatInletStream != null)
			{
				if (HeatOutletStream != null)
				{
					ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds;
				}
				else
				{
					ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds_InletHeat;
				}
			}
			else if (HeatOutletStream != null)
			{
				ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds_OutletHeat;
			}
			else
			{
				ElectrolyzerImage = ImageResources.ElectrolyzerStack_2Feeds_NoHeat;
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{

			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void ClearAllData()
		{
			ReactionCollection.Clear();
			ReactionSet_Selected = string.Empty;
		}

		private void SetDefaultValue()
		{
			string parentElementPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.SSCompGenerateRates";
			IEnumerable<string> elementCollection = GetElementCollection(parentElementPath);
			ReactionCollection.Clear();
			foreach (string item in elementCollection)
			{
				ReactionCollection.Add(item);
			}
			if (_reactionCollection != null && _reactionCollection.Count() >= 1)
			{
				ReactionSet_Selected = _reactionCollection.FirstOrDefault();
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetElementCollection(string parentElementPath)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, parentElementPath, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || !val.success)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
			{
				yield return item.attribute;
			}
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			if (_reactionSet_Selected == null || _view == null || _view.grdRates == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AdsField val = _view.grdRates.Fields.FirstOrDefault((AdsField f) => f.Key.Equals("MoleRates"));
			if (_reactionSet_Selected.StartsWith("NC"))
			{
				val.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				val.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				string text = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.SSCompGenerateRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.MoleRateUnitType";
				AccessorElement val2 = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val2 != null && val2.success && val != null && val2.value != null)
				{
					int result = 0;
					if (int.TryParse(val2.value.ToString(), out result))
					{
						val.UnitsKind = result;
					}
				}
			}
			AdsField val3 = _view.grdRates.Fields.FirstOrDefault((AdsField f) => f.Key.Equals("MassRates"));
			string text2 = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.SSCompGenerateRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.MassRateUnitType";
			AccessorElement val4 = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text2, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val4 != null && val4.success && val3 != null && val4.value != null)
			{
				int result2 = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(val4.value.ToString(), out result2))
				{
					val3.UnitsKind = result2;
				}
			}
			_view.grdRates.UpdateDataGrid();
			_view.grdRates.InvalidateGridData();
		}
	}

		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)_view).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, (Action)delegate
			{
				RefreshFormControl();
			});
			base.OnSimulationRunCompleted();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationRunFailed()
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)_view).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, (Action)delegate
			{
				RefreshFormControl();
			});
			base.OnSimulationRunFailed();
		}

		public override void OnSimulationReinitialized()
		{
			ClearAllData();
			base.OnSimulationReinitialized();
		}

		private void ClearAllData()
		{
			ReactionSet_Selected = string.Empty;
			ReactionCollection.Clear();
		}

		private void RefreshFormControl()
		{
			if (_view != null)
			{
				if (((UIElement)(object)_view).IsEnabled)
				{
					InitData();
					return;
				}
				ReactionSet_Selected = string.Empty;
				ReactionCollection.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void InitData()
		{
			ReactionCollection.Clear();
			string parentElementPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates";
			foreach (string item in GetElementCollection(parentElementPath))
			{
				if (IsAvailableItem(item))
				{
					ReactionCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (_reactionCollection != null && _reactionCollection.Count() >= 1)
			{
				ReactionSet_Selected = _reactionCollection.FirstOrDefault();
			}
		}

		private bool IsAvailableItem(string reactionString)
		{
			string text = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates.{reactionString}.CustomTerm.#0";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || !val.success)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetElementCollection(string parentElementPath)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, parentElementPath, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val != null && val.success)
			{
				IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
				if (elementChildren != null)
				{
					foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
					{
						list.Add(item.attribute);
					}
					list.Sort((IComparer<string>)new ObjectNameComparer());
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			if (_reactionSet_Selected != null && _view != null && _view.grdTerm != null && _view.grdVariable != null)
			{
				_view.grdTerm.UpdateDataGrid();
				_view.grdTerm.InvalidateGridData();
				_view.grdVariable.UpdateDataGrid();
				_view.grdVariable.InvalidateGridData();
			}

	internal class StoicMatrixGridBuilder
	{
		private readonly List<AdsPropertyInfo> _adsProperties = new List<AdsPropertyInfo>

		internal (List<AdsManualLayoutColumn>, List<AdsManualLayoutRow>) GetGridData(IAdbTopProvider adbTopProvider, AccessorElement stoicMatrix, string stoicMatrixADSPath)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_01df: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<AdsManualLayoutColumn> list = new List<AdsManualLayoutColumn>();
			List<AdsManualLayoutRow> list2 = new List<AdsManualLayoutRow>();
			List<AccessorElement> list3 = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(adbTopProvider, stoicMatrix)?.ToList();
			if (list3 == null || list3.Count < 1)
			{
				return (list, list2);
			}
			list.Add(new AdsManualLayoutColumn
			{
				Header = BatchOpResources.Component,
				Width = 100.0
			});

				AdsManualLayoutRow val = new AdsManualLayoutRow();

				{
					Text = name
				});

				{
					TryGetAdsPropertyInfo(AdbExtensions.GetName(element), out adsPropertyInfo);
					return adsPropertyInfo.DisplayOrder;
				}))
				{
					string name2 = AdbExtensions.GetName(item2);
					List<AccessorElement> list4 = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(adbTopProvider, item2).ToList();
					if (list4.Count <= 0)
					{
						if (flag && GetLocalizedColumnHeader(name2) != null)
						{
							list.Add(new AdsManualLayoutColumn
							{
								Header = GetLocalizedColumnHeader(name2),
								Width = 100.0
							});
						}
						ObservableCollection<AdsManualLayoutElementBase> elements = val.Elements;
						AdsTextBlockElement val2 = new AdsTextBlockElement();
						val2.ValuePath = stoicMatrixADSPath + "." + name + "." + name2;
						elements.Add((AdsManualLayoutElementBase)(object)val2);
						continue;
					}
					foreach (AccessorElement item3 in list4)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							list.Add(new AdsManualLayoutColumn
							{
								Header = GetLocalizedColumnHeader(name2, item3.attribute),
								Width = 130.0
							});
						}
						ObservableCollection<AdsManualLayoutElementBase> elements2 = val.Elements;

						val2.ValuePath = stoicMatrixADSPath + "." + name + "." + name2 + "." + item3.attribute;
						elements2.Add((AdsManualLayoutElementBase)(object)val2);
					}
				}
				list2.Add(val);
				flag = list.Count < 1;
			}
			return (list, list2);
		}

		private string GetLocalizedColumnHeader(string propertyName, string componentID = null)
		{
			if (!TryGetAdsPropertyInfo(propertyName, out var adsPropertyInfo))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = adsPropertyInfo.LocalizedValue;
			if (text != null && text.Contains("{0}"))
			{
				text = ((componentID == null) ? null : string.Format(text, componentID));
			}
			return text;
		}

		private bool TryGetAdsPropertyInfo(string propertyName, out AdsPropertyInfo adsPropertyInfo)
		{
			foreach (AdsPropertyInfo adsProperty in _adsProperties)
			{
				if (propertyName == adsProperty.PropertyName)
				{
					adsPropertyInfo = adsProperty;
					return true;
				}
			}
			adsPropertyInfo = AdsPropertyInfo.Empty;
			return false;
		}

		private void SetUnitForFields()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_reactionSet_Selected))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> obj = new List<string>
			{
				$"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues.#0.HoldUpUnitType",
				$"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues.#0.CatMassUnitType",
				$"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.KineticValues.#0.ExtentUnitType"
			};
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string item in obj)
			{
				num++;
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, item, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val == null || !val.success || val.value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(val.value.ToString(), out result))
				{
					switch (num)
					{
					case 1:
						HoldUpUnitType = result;
						break;
					case 2:
						CatMassUnitType = result;
						break;
					case 3:
						ExtentUnitType = result;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			if (_reactionSet_Selected != null && _view != null && _view.grdReacRates != null)
			{
				_view.grdReacRates.IndexerPath = "@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates.@ReactionSet.KineticValues";
				_view.grdReacRates.UpdateDataGrid();
				_view.grdReacRates.InvalidateGridData();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshReationType()
		{
			string text = $"@main.SharedData.kineticResults.CurrentKineticResults.ReactionSetRates.{_reactionSet_Selected}.ReationType";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val != null && val.value != null)
			{
				ReactionType = val.value.ToString();
				if (ReactionType.ToUpper() == "FERMENTATION")
				{
					ReactionIDEnabled = Visibility.Collapsed;
					RateUnitTypeEnabled = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else
				{
					ReactionIDEnabled = Visibility.Visible;
					RateUnitTypeEnabled = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public PotGeometry PotGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (_potGeometry == null)
				{
					_potGeometry = new PotGeometry(this);
					_potGeometry.GeometryChanged += _potGeometry_InputChanged;
					_potGeometry.ClearRequested += _potGeometry_ClearRequested;
					_potGeometry.CutRequested += _potGeometry_CutRequested;
					_potGeometry.CopyRequested += _potGeometry_CopyRequested;
					_potGeometry.PasteRequested += _potGeometry_PasteRequested;
					_potGeometry.Dragging += _potGeometry_Dragging;
				}
				return _potGeometry;
			}
		}

		private void _potGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

			}
		}

		private void _potGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_hasInitilized)
			{
				return;
			}
			InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute);
			if (e.Value == null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value);
				inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (sender is GeometryVariable)
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute));
				}
			}
			else if (obj != null && obj.ToString() != e.Value.ToString())
			{
				if (!((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value))
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(obj);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.CC Nodes.RSPEC"));
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private void UpdateGeometry(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.Volume.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TopHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TopHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.BottomHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.BottomHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.IsVertical = bool.Parse(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.POTORIENT", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("HORIZONTAL", "False")
				.Replace("VERTICAL", "True"));
			PotGeometry.GeoSpec = (GeoSpec)Enum.Parse(typeof(GeoSpec), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_2", "DV")
				.Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_3", "LV"));
			UpdateHeatXGeometry();
			if (!PotGeometry.Diameter.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.LV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.Volume.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DL)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			switch (PotGeometry.GeoSpec)
			{
			case GeoSpec.DL:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.DV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.LV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			}
			PotGeometry.LoadCompleted = true;
			_hasInitilized = true;
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@@main.Input.EQUIP_MODE", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch);
			if (geometryCalculation && (lastSpec == PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString() || lastSpec == null) && (obj == null || !(obj.ToString() == "CONCEPTUAL")))
			{
				PotGeometry.CalculateGeometry();
			}
			lastSpec = PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString();
		}

		private void CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Update(geometryCalculation: true);
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetElementCollection(string parentElementPath)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, parentElementPath, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val != null && val.success)
			{
				IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
				if (elementChildren != null)
				{
					return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement item) => item.attribute);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool HaveResults(string path)
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, path, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
			if (elementChildren == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (AccessorElement item in elementChildren)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			MMRCSTR_Result v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRCSTR_Result;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.tabCustomReactions.Accessible = HasCustomReactionsResults;
					v.tabCompRates.Accessible = HasComponentRatesResults;
					v.tabReactionRates.Accessible = HasReactionRatesResults;
					v.tab11.Accessible = HasFermentationResults;
					v.tabMassTransfer.Accessible = HasMassTransferResults;
				}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
			}
		}

		private void DisEnableTab()
		{
			MMRCSTR_Result v = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMRCSTR_Result;
			if (v != null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)v).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					v.tabCustomReactions.Accessible = false;
					v.tabCompRates.Accessible = false;
					v.tabReactionRates.Accessible = false;
					v.tab11.Accessible = false;
					v.tabMassTransfer.Accessible = false;
				}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActivity()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.ACT_VALUE");
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array2[i].Contains("#"))
				{
					((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChild(text, num);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		}

		private void _potGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_hasInitilized)
			{
				return;
			}
			InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute);
			if (e.Value == null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value);
				inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (sender is GeometryVariable)
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute));
				}
			}
			else if (obj != null && obj.ToString() != e.Value.ToString())
			{
				if (!((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value))
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(obj);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.CC Nodes.RSPEC"));
				}
			}
		}

			}
			UpdateGeometry(geometryCalculation);
			_cxvPropertyWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged += CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
		}

		private void CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Update(geometryCalculation: true);
		}

		private void UpdateGeometry(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.Volume.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TopHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TopHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.BottomHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.BottomHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.IsVertical = bool.Parse(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.POTORIENT", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("HORIZONTAL", "False")
				.Replace("VERTICAL", "True"));
			PotGeometry.GeoSpec = (GeoSpec)Enum.Parse(typeof(GeoSpec), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_2", "DV")
				.Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_3", "LV"));
			if (!PotGeometry.Diameter.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.LV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.Volume.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DL)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			switch (PotGeometry.GeoSpec)
			{
			case GeoSpec.DL:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.DV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.LV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			}
			PotGeometry.LoadCompleted = true;
			_hasInitilized = true;
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.HTRANMODE", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch);
			if (geometryCalculation && (lastSpec == PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString() || lastSpec == null) && (obj == null || !(obj.ToString() == "SHORTCUT")))
			{
				PotGeometry.CalculateGeometry();
			}
			lastSpec = PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString();
		}

			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				MMTabItem val = null;

				{
					if (((UIElement)(object)item).Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ((TabItem)(object)item).IsSelected)
					{

					}
				}

					((TabItem)(object)val).IsSelected = true;
				}
			});
		}

		private static void GetFluidProps(object mapVar, string varName, MMTabPageViewModel model)
		{
			string inputUri = Registry.GetValue("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\AspenTech\\AMSystem\\37.0\\Dir", "Bin", "").ToString() + "ThermalFluidLibrary.xml";
			CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((mapVar is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? mapVar : null);
			using XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(inputUri);
			while (xmlReader.Read())
			{
				if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || !(xmlReader.Name == "ThermalFluid") || !(xmlReader.GetAttribute("componentname") == val.SelectedItem))
				{
					continue;
				}
				XmlReader xmlReader2 = xmlReader.ReadSubtree();
				while (xmlReader2.Read())
				{
					if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
					{
						continue;
					}
					XmlReader xmlReader3 = xmlReader.ReadSubtree();
					switch (xmlReader.Name)
					{
					case "MULDIP":
						while (xmlReader3.Read())
						{
							if (xmlReader3.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element)
							{
								switch (xmlReader3.Name)
								{
								case "A":
									((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input." + varName + ".#0", "value", (object)xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsDouble());
									break;
								case "B":
									((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input." + varName + ".#1", "value", (object)xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsDouble());
									break;
								case "C":
									((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input." + varName + ".#2", "value", (object)xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsDouble());
									break;
								case "D":
									((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input." + varName + ".#3", "value", (object)xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsDouble());
									break;
								case "E":

									break;
								case "Tlower":
									((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input." + varName + ".#5", "value", (object)xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsDouble());
									break;

									((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input." + varName + ".#6", "value", (object)xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsDouble());
									break;

							}

		public static bool SetFluidLibraryValues(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName, MMTabPageViewModel model, string FluidLibraryVariable, string FluidLibraryActiveCCPath, string FluidLibraryValuePath, string FluidPropertiesActiveCCPath, string ThermalFluidPropertiesOptionValuePath, object FluidPropOpt_MultiMap, object Library_MultiMap)
		{
			bool result = false;
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(FluidPropertiesActiveCCPath, "value"));
			if (num.HasValue && num == 1 && pd.Name == "FluidPropOpt_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(ThermalFluidPropertiesOptionValuePath, "value"));
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((FluidPropOpt_MultiMap is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? FluidPropOpt_MultiMap : null);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text == "PROPERTY" && val.Value.ToString() == "FluidPropOpt_MultiMapOption_1")
				{
					GetFluidProps(Library_MultiMap, FluidLibraryVariable, model);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(FluidLibraryActiveCCPath, "value"));
			if (num2.HasValue && num2 == 1 && pd.Name == "Library_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(FluidLibraryValuePath, "value"));
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val2 = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((Library_MultiMap is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? Library_MultiMap : null);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2 != val2.Value.ToString())
				{
					GetFluidProps(Library_MultiMap, FluidLibraryVariable, model);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
