	internal class ReferenceLineMarginConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			if (values[2].ToString() == "True")
			{
				if (parameter.ToString() == "BottomHeightLine")
				{
					return values[1].ToString() switch
					{
						"HEMISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(292.0, 208.0, 0.0, 56.0), 
						"FLAT" => new Thickness(292.0, 208.0, 0.0, 125.0), 
						"TORISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(292.0, 208.0, 0.0, 91.0), 
						_ => new Thickness(292.0, 208.0, 0.0, 93.0), 
					};
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "TopHeightLine")
				{
					return values[1].ToString() switch
					{
						"HEMISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(254.0, 157.0, 0.0, 66.0), 
						"FLAT" => new Thickness(254.0, 157.0, 0.0, 135.0), 
						"TORISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(254.0, 157.0, 0.0, 101.0), 
						_ => new Thickness(254.0, 157.0, 0.0, 103.0), 
					};
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "TantanLine")
				{
					if (values[0].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL" && values[1].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(0.0, 66.0, 303.0, 133.0);
					}
					if (values[0].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(0.0, 66.0, 303.0, 135.0);
					}
					if (values[1].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(0.0, 68.0, 303.0, 133.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(0.0, 68.0, 303.0, 135.0);
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "CoilTantanLine")
				{
					if (values[0].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL" && values[1].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(150.0, 66.0, 0.0, 133.5);
					}
					if (values[0].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(150.0, 66.0, 0.0, 136.0);
					}
					if (values[1].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(150.0, 68.0, 0.0, 133.5);
					}
					return new Thickness(150.0, 68.0, 0.0, 136.0);
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "JacketTopHeightLine")
				{
					return values[1].ToString() switch
					{
						"HEMISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(144.0, 87.0, 0.0, 68.5), 
						"FLAT" => new Thickness(144.0, 87.0, 0.0, 135.0), 
						"CONICAL" => new Thickness(144.0, 87.0, 0.0, 104.0), 
						_ => new Thickness(144.0, 87.0, 0.0, 103.0), 
					};
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "JacketBottomLine")
				{
					string text = values[1].ToString();
					if (!(text == "HEMISPHERICAL"))
					{
						if (text == "FLAT")
						{
							return new Thickness(90.0, 200.0, 0.0, 125.0);
						}
						return new Thickness(90.0, 214.0, 0.0, 93.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(90.0, 214.0, 0.0, 57.0);
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "FullJacketViewbox")
				{
					string text = values[1].ToString();
					if (!(text == "HEMISPHERICAL"))
					{
						if (text == "FLAT")
						{
							return new Thickness(165.0, 56.0, 325.0, 105.0);
						}
						return new Thickness(165.0, 50.0, 325.0, 75.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(167.0, 40.0, 328.0, 46.0);
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "PartialJacketViewbox")
				{
					string text = values[1].ToString();
					if (!(text == "HEMISPHERICAL"))
					{
						if (text == "FLAT")
						{
							return new Thickness(165.0, 57.0, 325.0, 124.0);
						}
						return new Thickness(165.0, 56.0, 325.0, 109.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(167.0, 53.0, 328.0, 105.0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (parameter.ToString() == "BottomHeightLine")
				{
					return values[0].ToString() switch
					{
						"HEMISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(294.0, 0.0, 166.0, 57.0), 
						"TORISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(294.0, 0.0, 223.0, 57.0), 
						"FLAT" => new Thickness(294.0, 0.0, 266.0, 57.0), 
						"CONICAL" => new Thickness(294.0, 0.0, 223.0, 55.0), 
						_ => new Thickness(294.0, 0.0, 225.0, 57.0), 
					};
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "TopHeightLine")
				{
					return values[0].ToString() switch
					{
						"HEMISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(363.0, 0.0, 166.0, 10.0), 
						"TORISPHERICAL" => new Thickness(363.0, 0.0, 223.0, 10.0), 
						"FLAT" => new Thickness(363.0, 0.0, 266.0, 10.0), 
						"CONICAL" => new Thickness(363.0, 0.0, 223.0, 10.0), 
						_ => new Thickness(363.0, 0.0, 225.0, 10.0), 
					};
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "JacketTop")
				{
					switch (values[0].ToString())
					{
					case "HEMISPHERICAL":
						return new Thickness(181.0, 0.0, 167.0, 35.0);
					case "CONICAL":
					case "TORISPHERICAL":
						return new Thickness(181.0, 0.0, 222.0, 35.0);
					case "FLAT":
						return new Thickness(181.0, 0.0, 266.0, 35.0);
					default:
						return new Thickness(181.0, 0.0, 227.0, 35.0);
					}
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "JacketTanTan")
				{
					if (values[0].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(147.0, -58.0, 264.0, 0.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(150.0, -58.0, 267.0, 0.0);
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "CoilTantanLine")
				{
					if (values[0].ToString() == "HEMISPHERICAL")
					{
						return new Thickness(147.0, -58.0, 263.5, 0.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(150.0, -58.0, 267.0, 0.0);
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "FullJacketViewbox")
				{
					string text = values[0].ToString();
					if (!(text == "HEMISPHERICAL"))
					{
						if (text == "FLAT")
						{
							return new Thickness(211.0, -69.0, 287.0, 29.0);
						}
						return new Thickness(225.0, -90.0, 273.0, 8.0);
					}
					return new Thickness(248.0, -122.0, 252.0, -24.0);
				}
			}
			return new Thickness(0.0);
		}

		private void CutCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((ValueEditor)valueEditor).Text) && base.DataContext is InputVariable { DataSource: DataSource.UserInput } && ((UIElement)(object)valueEditor).IsEnabled)
			{
				e.CanExecute = true;
			}
			else
			{
				e.CanExecute = false;
			}
		}

		private void CutExecute(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(base.DataContext as InputVariable).OnCutRequested();
			((ValueEditor)valueEditor).Text = string.Empty;
		}

		private void CopyCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((ValueEditor)valueEditor).Text))
			{
				e.CanExecute = true;
			}
			else
			{
				e.CanExecute = false;
			}
		}

		private void CopyExecute(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(base.DataContext as InputVariable).OnCopyRequested();
		}

		private void PasteCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ClipboardWrapper.ContainsData(DataFormats.Text) && ((UIElement)(object)valueEditor).IsEnabled)
			{
				e.CanExecute = true;
			}
			else
			{
				e.CanExecute = false;
			}
		}

		private void PasteExecute(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(base.DataContext as InputVariable).OnPasteRequested();
		}

		private void ClearCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)

				e.CanExecute = true;

			else
			{
				e.CanExecute = false;
			}
		}

		private void ClearExecute(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)

		public InputControl()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				SetBinding();
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		private void SetBinding()
		{
			if (base.DataContext != null)
			{
				IValueConverter valueToTextConverter = ((!(base.DataContext is GeometryVariable)) ? ((IValueConverter)new InputVariableConverter()) : ((IValueConverter)new GeometryVariableValueConverter("G6", ((ValueEditor)valueEditor).Format, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat)));
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)valueEditor, ValueEditor.ValueProperty);
				Binding binding = new Binding
				{
					Source = base.DataContext,
					Path = new PropertyPath("Value"),
					ConverterCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
					Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay,
					UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.LostFocus,
					NotifyOnValidationError = true,
					UpdateSourceExceptionFilter = OnSourceExeptionFilter
				};
				((FrameworkElement)(object)valueEditor).SetBinding(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, (BindingBase)binding);
				((ValueEditor)valueEditor).ValueToTextConverter = valueToTextConverter;
			}
		}

		private object OnSourceExeptionFilter(object bindingExpression, Exception e)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private static void OnCustomNumericEditorWidthChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			}
		}

		private void valueEditor_EditModeStarted(object sender, EditModeStartedEventArgs e)

		private void valueEditor_EditModeEnded(object sender, EditModeEndedEventArgs e)

					((ValueEditor)val).Text = ((ValueEditor)val).Text;
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void UserControl_MouseRightButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ContextMenu = InitializeValueContextMenu();
			base.ContextMenu.IsOpen = true;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnDrop(DragEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnDrop(e);
			if (e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.Text))
			{
				string text = e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.Text).ToString();
				double result = 0.0;
				if (double.TryParse(text, out result))
				{
					((ValueEditor)valueEditor).Text = text;
					((UIElement)(object)valueEditor).Focus();
					Focus();
				}
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

				Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			switch (connectionId)
			{
			case 1:
				((InputControl)target).MouseRightButtonUp += UserControl_MouseRightButtonUp;
				break;
			case 2:
				valueEditor = (XamNumericEditor)target;
				((ValueEditor)valueEditor).EditModeStarted += valueEditor_EditModeStarted;
				((ValueEditor)valueEditor).EditModeEnded += valueEditor_EditModeEnded;
				((UIElement)(object)valueEditor).MouseRightButtonUp += valueEditor_MouseRightButtonUp;
				((ValueEditor)valueEditor).ValueChanged += valueEditor_ValueChanged;
				break;
			case 3:
				unitEditor = (XamComboEditor)target;
				((ValueEditor)unitEditor).EditModeStarted += unitEditor_EditModeStarted;
				((ValueEditor)unitEditor).EditModeEnded += unitEditor_EditModeEnded;
				((UIElement)(object)unitEditor).MouseRightButtonUp += unitEditor_MouseRightButtonUp;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataDragHelper
	{
		private System.Windows.Point? _startPos;

		private readonly InputControl _parent;

		public DataDragHelper(InputControl parent)
		{
			_parent = parent;
		}

		public void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((XamMaskedEditor)_parent.valueEditor).SelectionLength > 0)
			{
				_startPos = e.GetPosition(_parent);
			}
			else
			{
				_startPos = null;
			}
		}

		public void OnPreviewMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_startPos.HasValue && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && ((XamMaskedEditor)_parent.valueEditor).SelectionLength > 0 && (e.GetPosition(_parent) - _startPos.Value).Length > 5.0)
			{
				_startPos = null;
				e.Handled = true;
				StartDrag();
			}
		}

		private void StartDrag()
		{
			DataObject dataObject = new DataObject();
			dataObject.SetText(((ValueEditor)_parent.valueEditor).Text, TextDataFormat.Text);
			DraggingEventArgs e = new DraggingEventArgs(InputControl.DataDragStartingEvent, _parent, dataObject, _parent.DataContext as GeometryVariable);
			_parent.OnDataDragStarting(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				DragDrop.DoDragDrop(_parent, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
			}
		}

		public void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			e.GetPosition(_parent);
			_startPos = null;
		}
	}
	public class DraggingEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		public IDataObject DataObject { get; private set; }

		public GeometryVariable GeometryVariable { get; private set; }

		public DraggingEventArgs(RoutedEvent routedEvent, object source, IDataObject dataObject, GeometryVariable ContextData)
			: base(routedEvent, source)
		{
			if (dataObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataObject");
			}
			if (ContextData == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ContextData");
			}
			DataObject = dataObject;
			GeometryVariable = ContextData;
		}
	}

			}
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				if (Orientation == Dock.Left)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Right)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalRight(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Top)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalTop(width, height);
				}
				return CreateGeometryForInternalBottom(width, height);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(10.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(10.0, height);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Bottom, point2, Dock.Top);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalRight(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(width - 10.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width - 10.0, height);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Bottom, point2, Dock.Top);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalTop(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 10.0);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Right, point2, Dock.Left);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalBottom(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height - 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height - 10.0);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Right, point2, Dock.Left);
		}

		private Geometry GenerateGeometry(System.Windows.Point p11, System.Windows.Point p12, System.Windows.Point p21, System.Windows.Point p22, System.Windows.Point p31, System.Windows.Point p32, System.Windows.Point bp1, Dock orientation1, System.Windows.Point bp2, Dock orientation2)
		{
			PathFigure item = null;
			PathFigure item2 = null;
			PathFigure pathFigure = null;
			PathFigure item3 = null;
			PathFigure item4 = null;
			if (IsFirstMarginalLineVisible)
			{
				item = new PathFigure(p11, new PathSegment[1]
				{
					new LineSegment(p12, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: false);
			}
			if (IsSecondMarginalLineVisible)
			{
				item2 = new PathFigure(p21, new PathSegment[1]
				{
					new LineSegment(p22, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: false);
			}
			pathFigure = new PathFigure(p31, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p32, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			if (IsFirstArrowVisible)
			{
				item3 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp1, orientation1);
			}
			if (IsSecondArrowVisible)
			{
				item4 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp2, orientation2);
			}
			List<PathFigure> obj = new List<PathFigure> { item, item2, pathFigure, item3, item4 };
			List<PathFigure> list = new List<PathFigure>();
			foreach (PathFigure item5 in obj)
			{
				if (item5 != null)
				{
					list.Add(item5);
				}
			}
			return new PathGeometry(list);
		}

		private PathFigure GenerateArrowFigure(System.Windows.Point basePoint, Dock orientation)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point;
			System.Windows.Point point2;
			switch (orientation)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, 7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, 7.0);
				break;
			default:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, -7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, -7.0);
				break;
			}
			return new PathFigure(basePoint, new PathSegment[2]
			{
				new LineSegment(point, isStroked: true),
				new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: true);
		}
	}
	public class BoolToBool : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value.ToString() == true.ToString())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class BoolToLayout : FrameworkElement, IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!bool.Parse(value.ToString()))
			{
				return FindResource("HorizontalLayout");
			}
			return FindResource("VerticalLayout");
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class BoolToVisibility : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value.ToString() == "True")
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public enum DataSource
	{
		Default,
		Calculated,
		UserInput
	}
	public class DataSourceToStyle : FrameworkElement, IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return FindResource(value.ToString()) as Style;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public abstract class GeometryBase : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private bool _isVertical;

		private GeoSpec _geoSpec;

		public GeometryVariable Diameter { get; set; }

		public GeometryVariable TanTanLength { get; set; }

		public GeometryVariable Volume { get; set; }

		public bool IsVertical
		{
			get
			{
				return _isVertical;
			}
			set
			{
				_isVertical = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("IsVertical");
			}
		}

		public GeoSpec GeoSpec
		{
			get
			{
				return _geoSpec;
			}
			set
			{
				_geoSpec = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("GeoSpec");
			}
		}

		public bool LoadCompleted { get; set; }

		public event InputChangedEventHandler GeometryChanged;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event ClearRequestedEventHandler ClearRequested;

		public event CutRequestedEventHandler CutRequested;

		public event CopyRequestedEventHandler CopyRequested;

		public event PasteRequestedEventHandler PasteRequested;

		public event DragingEventHandler Dragging;

		protected abstract double? CalculateVolume();

		protected abstract double? CalculateLength();

		protected abstract double? CalculateDiameter();

		public void CalculateGeometry()
		{
			if (!LoadCompleted)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DL)
			{
				if (Volume != null)
				{
					Volume.Value = CalculateVolume();
					if (Diameter.DataSource == DataSource.Calculated)
					{
						Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
					}
					if (TanTanLength.DataSource == DataSource.Calculated)
					{
						TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
					}
					Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				}
			}
			else if (GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DV)
			{
				if (TanTanLength != null)
				{
					TanTanLength.Value = CalculateLength();
					if (Diameter.DataSource == DataSource.Calculated)
					{
						Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
					}
					TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
					if (Volume.DataSource == DataSource.Calculated)
					{
						Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (GeoSpec == GeoSpec.LV && Diameter != null)
			{
				Diameter.Value = CalculateDiameter();
				Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				if (TanTanLength.DataSource == DataSource.Calculated)
				{
					TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
				}
				if (Volume.DataSource == DataSource.Calculated)
				{
					Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void OnGeometryChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			this.GeometryChanged?.Invoke(sender, e);
		}

		public void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		public void OnClearRequrested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			this.ClearRequested?.Invoke(sender, e);
		}

		public void OnCutRequrested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			this.CutRequested?.Invoke(sender, e);
		}

		public void OnCopyRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			this.CopyRequested?.Invoke(sender, e);
		}

		public void OnPasteRequrested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			this.PasteRequested?.Invoke(sender, e);
		}

		public void OnDragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			this.Dragging?.Invoke(sender, e);
		}
	}
	public class GeometryCalculator
	{
		public static double? CalculateConicalVolume(double? diameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			if (!diameter.HasValue || !coneHeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? obj = diameter / 2.0;
			return obj * obj * Math.PI * coneHeight / 3.0;
		}

		public static double? CalculateEllipticalVolume(double? diameter)
		{
			if (!diameter.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? obj = diameter / 2.0;
			return Math.PI / 3.0 * obj * obj * obj;
		}

		public static double? CalculateHemisphericalVolume(double? diameter)
		{
			if (!diameter.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? obj = diameter / 2.0;
			return 4.1887902047863905 * obj * obj * obj / 2.0;
		}

		public static double? CalculateTorisphericalVolume(double? diameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			if (!diameter.HasValue || !fD.HasValue || !kD.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = double.Parse(fD.ToString());
			double num2 = double.Parse(kD.ToString());
			double num3 = 0.001;
			double num4 = Math.Asin((1.0 - 2.0 * num2) / Math.Max(2.0 * (num - num2), num3));
			double num5 = num * diameter.Value * (1.0 - Math.Cos(num4));
			double num6 = num2 * diameter.Value * Math.Cos(num4);
			double num7 = 2.0 * num * diameter.Value * Math.Sin(num4);
			double num8 = num2 * num2 * diameter.Value * diameter.Value * Math.Sin(num4) * Math.Sin(num4);
			double num9 = 2.0 * num6;
			return Math.PI / 4.0 * (2.0 * num5 * num5 * num5 / 3.0 + num5 * num7 * num7 / 2.0) + Math.PI * num9 / 2.0 * ((diameter.Value / 2.0 - num2 * diameter.Value) * (diameter.Value / 2.0 - num2 * diameter.Value) + num8) + Math.PI * num9 * num9 * num9 / 12.0 + Math.PI * diameter.Value * (1.0 - 2.0 * num2) * (num9 * Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(num3 * num3, num8)) / 4.0 + num2 * num2 * diameter.Value * diameter.Value / 2.0 * Math.Asin(Math.Cos(num4)));
		}

		public static double? CalculateBodyVolume(double? diameter, double? height)
		{
			if (!diameter.HasValue || !height.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? obj = diameter / 2.0;
			return Math.PI * obj * obj * height;
		}

		public static double? CalculateFlatLength(double? diameter, double? volume)
		{
			if (!diameter.HasValue || diameter == 0.0 || !volume.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = diameter.Value / 2.0;
			return volume / (Math.PI * num * num);
		}

		public static double? CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(double? length, double? volume)
		{
			if (!length.HasValue || !volume.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (length.Value == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return 2.0 * Math.Sqrt(volume.Value / length.Value / Math.PI);
		}

		public static double? CalculateFlatEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? volume)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetFlatEllipticalDiameter(length, num3)) / GetPrimeFlatEllipticalDiameter(length, num3);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetFlatEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return Math.PI / 24.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (6.0 * length + resultDiameter);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeFlatEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 8.0 * resultDiameter * (8.0 * length + resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateEllipticalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? volume)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetEllipticalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3)) / GetPrimeEllipticalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetEllipticalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (resultDiameter + 3.0 * length);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeEllipticalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 4.0 * resultDiameter * (2.0 * length + resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateFlatHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? volume)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetFlatHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3)) / GetPrimeFlatHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetFlatHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (resultDiameter + 3.0 * length);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeFlatHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 4.0 * resultDiameter * (2.0 * length + resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateHemisphericalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? volume)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetHemisphericalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3)) / GetPrimeHemisphericalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetHemisphericalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return Math.PI / 8.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (resultDiameter + 2.0 * length);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeHemisphericalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 8.0 * resultDiameter * (4.0 * length + 3.0 * resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateHemisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? volume)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetHemisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3)) / GetPrimeHemisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetHemisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (2.0 * resultDiameter + 3.0 * length);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeHemisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 2.0 * resultDiameter * (resultDiameter + length);
		}

		public static double? CalculateFlatConicalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? coneHeight)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !coneHeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetFlatConicalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight)) / GetPrimeFlatConicalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetFlatConicalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (3.0 * length + 2.0 * coneHeight);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeFlatConicalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 6.0 * resultDiameter * (3.0 * length + 2.0 * coneHeight);
		}

		public static double? CalculateConicalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? coneHeight)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !coneHeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetConicalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight)) / GetPrimeConicalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetConicalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return Math.PI / 24.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (6.0 * length + 4.0 * coneHeight + resultDiameter);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeConicalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 24.0 * resultDiameter * (8.0 * coneHeight + 3.0 * (4.0 * length + resultDiameter));
		}

		public static double? CalculateConicalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? coneHeight)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !coneHeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetConicalHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight)) / GetPrimeConicalHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetConicalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (3.0 * length + 2.0 * coneHeight + resultDiameter);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeConicalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * (6.0 * length + 4.0 * coneHeight + 3.0 * resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateConicalConicalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? coneHeight)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !coneHeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetFlatEllipticalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight)) / GetPrimeFlatEllipticalDiameter(length, num3, coneHeight);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetFlatEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return Math.PI / 12.0 * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (3.0 * length + 2.0 * coneHeight);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeFlatEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 6.0 * resultDiameter * (3.0 * length + 2.0 * coneHeight);
		}

		public static double? CalculateFlatTorisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !fD.HasValue || !kD.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetFlatTorisphericalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD)) / GetPrimeFlatTorisphericalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetFlatTorisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return Math.PI * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (length / 4.0 + CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeFlatTorisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return (0.0 - Math.PI * resultDiameter / 2.0) * (length + 6.0 * CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateTorisphericalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !kD.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetTorisphericalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD)) / GetPrimeTorisphericalEllipticalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetTorisphericalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return Math.PI * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (length / 4.0 + CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter + resultDiameter / 24.0);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeTorisphericalEllipticalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return (0.0 - Math.PI * resultDiameter / 8.0) * (4.0 * length + 24.0 * CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter + resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateTorisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !kD.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetTorisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD)) / GetPrimeTorisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetTorisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return Math.PI * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (length / 4.0 + CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter + resultDiameter / 12.0);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeTorisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return (0.0 - Math.PI * resultDiameter / 4.0) * (2.0 * length + 12.0 * CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter + resultDiameter);
		}

		public static double? CalculateTorisphericalConicalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? fD, double? kD, double? coneHeight)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !kD.HasValue || !coneHeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetTorisphericalConicalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD, coneHeight)) / GetPrimeTorisphericalConicalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD, coneHeight);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetTorisphericalConicalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return Math.PI * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (length / 4.0 + CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter + coneHeight / 6.0);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeTorisphericalConicalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD, double? coneHeight)
		{
			return (0.0 - Math.PI * resultDiameter / 6.0) * (2.0 * coneHeight + 3.0 * (length + 6.0 * CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter));
		}

		public static double? CalculateTorisphericalTorisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? volume, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			double num = 1E-05;
			double num2 = 1000.0;
			int i = 0;
			double? num3 = CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(length, volume);
			if (!num3.HasValue || !kD.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? num4 = 0.0;
			for (; (double)i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (!(Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) > num))
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = num3;
				num3 -= (volume - GetTorisphericalTorisphericalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD)) / GetPrimeTorisphericalTorisphericalDiameter(length, num3, fD, kD);
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num3.Value - num4.Value) <= num)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? GetTorisphericalTorisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return Math.PI * resultDiameter * resultDiameter * (length / 4.0 + 2.0 * CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter);
		}

		private static double? GetPrimeTorisphericalTorisphericalDiameter(double? length, double? resultDiameter, double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			return (0.0 - Math.PI * resultDiameter / 2.0) * (length + 12.0 * CalculateToriValue(fD, kD) * resultDiameter);
		}

		private static double? CalculateToriValue(double? fD, double? kD)
		{
			if (!fD.HasValue || !kD.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = Math.Asin((1.0 - 2.0 * kD.Value) / Math.Max(2.0 * (fD - kD).Value, 1E-05));
			double num2 = kD.Value * kD.Value;
			double num3 = num2 * kD.Value;
			double num4 = Math.Sin(num) * Math.Sin(num);
			double num5 = Math.Cos(num) * Math.Cos(num);
			double num6 = num5 * Math.Cos(num);
			return fD.Value * fD.Value * fD.Value / 6.0 * (1.0 - 3.0 * Math.Cos(num) + 3.0 * num5 - num6 + 3.0 * num4 - 3.0 * Math.Cos(num) * num4) + Math.Cos(num) / 4.0 * (kD.Value - 2.0 * num2 + 4.0 * num3) + num3 * Math.Cos(num) * (num4 + 2.0 * num5 / 3.0) + Math.Cos(num) * Math.Sin(num) * (num2 / 2.0 - num3) + Math.Asin(Math.Cos(num)) / 2.0 * (num2 - num3);
		}

		public static void ConvertUnit(int row, double value, string fromUnit, string toUnit, out double result)
		{
			result = Conversor.convertValueFromTo(value, row, fromUnit, toUnit);
		}
	}

		DL,
		DV,
		LV
	}
	public class HeadToVisibility : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (values[2].ToString() == "True")
			{
				if (parameter.ToString() == "ConeTop" && values[0].ToString() == "CONICAL" && values[1].ToString() != "CONICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if ((parameter.ToString() == "DishTop" || parameter.ToString() == "KnuckeTop") && values[0].ToString() == "TORISPHERICAL" && values[1].ToString() != "TORISPHERICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "ConeBottom" && values[0].ToString() != "CONICAL" && values[1].ToString() == "CONICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "ConeBottom" && values[0].ToString() == "CONICAL" && values[1].ToString() == "CONICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if ((parameter.ToString() == "DishBottom" || parameter.ToString() == "KnuckeBottom") && values[0].ToString() != "TORISPHERICAL" && values[1].ToString() == "TORISPHERICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if ((parameter.ToString() == "DishBottom" || parameter.ToString() == "KnuckeBottom") && values[0].ToString() == "TORISPHERICAL" && values[1].ToString() == "TORISPHERICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (parameter.ToString() == "ConeTop" && values[0].ToString() == "CONICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if ((parameter.ToString() == "DishTop" || parameter.ToString() == "KnuckeTop") && values[0].ToString() == "TORISPHERICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (parameter.ToString() == "BottomHeightLine" && values[0].ToString() != "HEMISPHERICAL")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		public HeatXferGeometry()
		{
			JacketTopHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.JKTOPHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Jacket_top_height);
			JacketBottomHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.JKBTMHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Jacket_bottom_height);
			CoilTopHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.COITOPHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Coil_top_height);
			CoilBottomHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.COIBTMHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Coil_bottom_height);
			HandleEvent();
		}

		private void HandleEvent()
		{
			JacketTopHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			JacketBottomHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			CoilTopHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			CoilBottomHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			JacketTopHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			JacketBottomHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			CoilTopHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			CoilBottomHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			JacketTopHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			JacketBottomHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			CoilTopHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			CoilBottomHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			JacketTopHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			JacketBottomHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			CoilTopHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			CoilBottomHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			JacketTopHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			JacketBottomHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			CoilTopHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			CoilBottomHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			JacketTopHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			JacketBottomHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			CoilTopHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			CoilBottomHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
		}

		public override void OnGeometryChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGeometryChanged(sender, e);
		}

	public class InputVariable : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private bool _isEnabled;

		private bool _hasUnit;

		private DataSource _dataSource;

		public string DataPath { get; set; }

		public string Caption { get; set; }

		public string ToolTip { get; set; }

		public bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _isEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_isEnabled = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("IsEnabled");
			}
		}

		public bool HasUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return _hasUnit;
			}
			set
			{
				_hasUnit = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("HasUnit");
			}
		}

		public DataSource DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return _dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				_dataSource = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("DataSource");
			}
		}

		public event InputChangedEventHandler InputChanged;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event ClearRequestedEventHandler ClearRequested;

		public event CutRequestedEventHandler CutRequested;

		public event CopyRequestedEventHandler CopyRequested;

		public event PasteRequestedEventHandler PasteRequested;

		public event DragingEventHandler Dragging;

		protected void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		public InputVariable(string path, string caption, string tooltip)
		{
			DataPath = path;
			Caption = caption;
			ToolTip = tooltip;
			IsEnabled = true;
			HasUnit = true;
		}

		private void OnInputChanged(object value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			this.InputChanged?.Invoke(this, new InputChangedEventArgs(typeof(CxsStandardAttributes).GetField(propertyName).GetValue(null).ToString(), value));
		}

		public void OnClearRequested()
		{
			this.ClearRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void OnCutRequested()
		{
			this.CutRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void OnCopyRequested()
		{
			this.CopyRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void OnPasteRequested()
		{
			this.PasteRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void OnDragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.Dragging != null)
			{
				this.Dragging(sender, args);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool SetProperty<T>(ref T property, T newValue, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (object.Equals(property, newValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			property = newValue;
			OnInputChanged(newValue, propertyName);
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class InputVariableConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double && targetType == typeof(string))
			{
				return double.Parse(value.ToString()).ToString("N3");
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}

		public PotGeometry(CxsDataHelper geometryVM)
		{
			geometryCxs = geometryVM;
			base.Diameter = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.POTDIAM", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_Diameter)
			{
				UnitsRow = 17
			};
			base.TanTanLength = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.POTLENGTAN", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_TanTanLength)
			{
				UnitsRow = 17
			};
			TopHead = new HeadVariable("@main.Input.POTTOPHEAD", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_TopHeadType);
			BottomHead = new HeadVariable("@main.Input.POTBTMHEAD", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_BottomHeadType);
			ConeHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.POTCONEHT", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_ConeHeight)
			{
				UnitsRow = 17
			};
			DishRadiusRatio = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.POTRATDISH", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_DishRadiusRatio, ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_DishRR_Range)
			{
				HasUnit = false
			};
			KnuckeRadiusRatio = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.POTRATKNCK", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_KnucheRadiusRatio, ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_KnRR_Range)
			{
				HasUnit = false
			};
			base.Volume = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.VOL", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_Volume)
			{
				UnitsRow = 27
			};
			JacketTopHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.JKTOPHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Jacket_top_height);
			JacketBottomHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.JKBTMHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Jacket_bottom_height);
			CoilTopHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.COITOPHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Coil_top_height);
			CoilBottomHeight = new GeometryVariable("@main.Input.COIBTMHG", ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_HeatXferGeometry_Coil_bottom_height);
			HandleEvent();
			HandleHeatXEvent();
		}

		private void HandleHeatXEvent()
		{
			JacketTopHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			JacketBottomHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			CoilTopHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			CoilBottomHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			JacketTopHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			JacketBottomHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			CoilTopHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			CoilBottomHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			JacketTopHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			JacketBottomHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			CoilTopHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			CoilBottomHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			JacketTopHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			JacketBottomHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			CoilTopHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			CoilBottomHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			JacketTopHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			JacketBottomHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			CoilTopHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			CoilBottomHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			JacketTopHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			JacketBottomHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			CoilTopHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			CoilBottomHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
		}

		private void HandleEvent()
		{
			base.Diameter.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			base.TanTanLength.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			TopHead.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			BottomHead.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			ConeHeight.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			DishRadiusRatio.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			KnuckeRadiusRatio.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			base.Volume.InputChanged += OnGeometryChanged;
			base.Diameter.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			base.TanTanLength.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			ConeHeight.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			DishRadiusRatio.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			KnuckeRadiusRatio.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			base.Volume.ClearRequested += base.OnClearRequrested;
			base.Diameter.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			base.TanTanLength.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			ConeHeight.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			DishRadiusRatio.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			KnuckeRadiusRatio.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			base.Volume.CutRequested += base.OnCutRequrested;
			base.Diameter.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			base.TanTanLength.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			ConeHeight.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			DishRadiusRatio.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			KnuckeRadiusRatio.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			base.Volume.CopyRequested += base.OnCopyRequested;
			base.Diameter.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			base.TanTanLength.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			ConeHeight.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			DishRadiusRatio.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			KnuckeRadiusRatio.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			base.Volume.PasteRequested += base.OnPasteRequrested;
			base.Diameter.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			base.TanTanLength.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			ConeHeight.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			DishRadiusRatio.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			KnuckeRadiusRatio.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
			base.Volume.Dragging += base.OnDragging;
		}

		protected override double? CalculateVolume()
		{
			if (!base.Diameter.Value.HasValue || !base.TanTanLength.Value.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.Diameter.UnitsRow, base.Diameter.Value.Value, base.Diameter.Units, "meter", out var result);
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.TanTanLength.UnitsRow, base.TanTanLength.Value.Value, base.TanTanLength.Units, "meter", out var result2);
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(ConeHeight.UnitsRow, ConeHeight.Value.Value, ConeHeight.Units, "meter", out var result3);
			double? num = CalculateHeadVolume(TopHead.Value, result, result3);
			double? num2 = ((!base.IsVertical) ? CalculateHeadVolume(TopHead.Value, result, result3) : CalculateHeadVolume(BottomHead.Value, result, result3));
			double? result4 = num + GeometryCalculator.CalculateBodyVolume(result, result2) + num2;
			if (result4.HasValue)
			{
				if (result4.Value < 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.Volume.UnitsRow, result4.Value, "cum", base.Volume.Units, out var result5);
				return double.Parse(result5.ToString("G6"));
			}
			return result4;
		}

		protected override double? CalculateLength()
		{
			if (!base.Diameter.Value.HasValue || !base.Volume.Value.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double? result = null;
			int num;
			int value;
			if (geometryCxs.GetRecdefVarValue("POTORIENT").ToString() == "HORIZONTAL")
			{
				num = (value = (int)TopHead.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				num = (int)TopHead.Value;
				value = (int)BottomHead.Value;
			}
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.Diameter.UnitsRow, base.Diameter.Value.Value, base.Diameter.Units, "meter", out var result2);
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.Volume.UnitsRow, base.Volume.Value.Value, base.Volume.Units, "cum", out var result3);
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(ConeHeight.UnitsRow, ConeHeight.Value.Value, ConeHeight.Units, "meter", out var result4);
			switch (num * value + num + value)
			{
			case 120:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(result2, result4) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(result2, result4));
				break;
			case 21:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(result2, result4) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 1110:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(result2, result4));
				break;
			case 11010:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(result2, result4) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 110010:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(result2, result4) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(result2) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 201:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 2001:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(result2) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 20001:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(result2) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value));
				break;
			case 10200:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3);
				break;
			case 101100:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 1010100:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value));
				break;
			case 1002000:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(result2) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(result2));
				break;
			case 10011000:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(result2) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value));
				break;
			case 100020000:
				result = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatLength(result2, result3 - GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value) - GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value));
				break;
			}
			if (result.HasValue)
			{
				if (result.Value < 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.TanTanLength.UnitsRow, result.Value, "meter", base.TanTanLength.Units, out var result5);
				return double.Parse(result5.ToString("G6"));
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override double? CalculateDiameter()
		{
			if (!base.TanTanLength.Value.HasValue || !base.Volume.Value.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.TanTanLength.UnitsRow, base.TanTanLength.Value.Value, base.TanTanLength.Units, "meter", out var result);
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.Volume.UnitsRow, base.Volume.Value.Value, base.Volume.Units, "cum", out var result2);
			GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(ConeHeight.UnitsRow, ConeHeight.Value.Value, ConeHeight.Units, "meter", out var result3);
			double? result4 = null;
			int num;
			int value;
			if (geometryCxs.GetRecdefVarValue("POTORIENT").ToString() == "HORIZONTAL")
			{
				num = (value = (int)TopHead.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				num = (int)TopHead.Value;
				value = (int)BottomHead.Value;
			}
			switch (num * value + num + value)
			{
			case 120:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalConicalDiameter(result, result2, result3);
				break;
			case 21:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalEllipticalDiameter(result, result2, result3);
				break;
			case 1110:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatConicalDiameter(result, result2, result3);
				break;
			case 11010:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalHemisphericalDiameter(result, result2, result3);
				break;
			case 110010:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalConicalDiameter(result, result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value, result3);
				break;
			case 3:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalEllipticalDiameter(result, result2);
				break;
			case 201:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatEllipticalDiameter(result, result2);
				break;
			case 2001:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalEllipticalDiameter(result, result2);
				break;
			case 20001:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalEllipticalDiameter(result, result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value);
				break;
			case 10200:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatFlatDiameter(result, result2);
				break;
			case 101100:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatHemisphericalDiameter(result, result2);
				break;
			case 1010100:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateFlatTorisphericalDiameter(result, result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value);
				break;
			case 1002000:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(result, result2);
				break;
			case 10011000:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalHemisphericalDiameter(result, result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value);
				break;
			case 100020000:
				result4 = GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalTorisphericalDiameter(result, result2, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value);
				break;
			}
			if (result4.HasValue)
			{
				if (result4.Value < 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				GeometryCalculator.ConvertUnit(base.Diameter.UnitsRow, result4.Value, "meter", base.Diameter.Units, out var result5);
				return double.Parse(result5.ToString("G6"));
			}
			return result4;
		}

		private double? CalculateHeadVolume(HeadType headType, double diameter, double cone = 0.0)
		{
			double? result;
			switch (headType)
			{
			case HeadType.ELLIPTICAL:
				return GeometryCalculator.CalculateEllipticalVolume(diameter);
			case HeadType.CONICAL:
				return GeometryCalculator.CalculateConicalVolume(diameter, cone);
			case HeadType.FLAT:
				result = 0.0;
				break;
			case HeadType.HEMISPHERICAL:
				return GeometryCalculator.CalculateHemisphericalVolume(diameter);
			case HeadType.TORISPHERICAL:
				return GeometryCalculator.CalculateTorisphericalVolume(diameter, DishRadiusRatio.Value, KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value);
			default:
				result = 0.0;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void OnGeometryChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is GeometryVariable geometryVariable)
			{
				if (geometryVariable.Caption == DishRadiusRatio.Caption)
				{
					DishInfo = " x Diameter = " + geometryVariable.Value * base.Diameter.Value + geometryVariable.Units;
				}
				if (geometryVariable.Caption == KnuckeRadiusRatio.Caption)
				{
					KnuckeInfo = " x Diameter = " + geometryVariable.Value * base.Diameter.Value + geometryVariable.Units;
				}
			}
			base.OnGeometryChanged(sender, e);
		}
	}

				if (!(base.Resources[key] is DataTemplate result))

	public class ReferenceLine : Shape
	{
		private const double ArrowWidth = 4.0;

		private const double ArrowHeight = 7.0;

		private const double ArrowLineOffset = 10.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Dock), typeof(ReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Dock.Right, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsExternalMarkingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsExternalMarking", typeof(bool), typeof(ReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ExternalOffset1Property = DependencyProperty.Register("ExternalOffset1", typeof(double), typeof(ReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(10.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ExternalOffset2Property = DependencyProperty.Register("ExternalOffset2", typeof(double), typeof(ReferenceLine), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(10.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public Dock Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsExternalMarking
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsExternalMarkingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsExternalMarkingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ExternalOffset1
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ExternalOffset1Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ExternalOffset1Property, value);
			}
		}

		public double ExternalOffset2
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ExternalOffset2Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ExternalOffset2Property, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				if (IsExternalMarking)
				{
					if (Orientation == Dock.Left)
					{
						return CreateGeometryForExternalLeft(width, height);
					}
					if (Orientation == Dock.Right)
					{
						return CreateGeometryForExternalRight(width, height);
					}
					if (Orientation == Dock.Top)
					{
						return CreateGeometryForExternalTop(width, height);
					}
					return CreateGeometryForExternalBottom(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Left)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Right)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalRight(width, height);
				}
				if (Orientation == Dock.Top)
				{
					return CreateGeometryForInternalTop(width, height);
				}
				return CreateGeometryForInternalBottom(width, height);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(10.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(10.0, height);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Bottom, point2, Dock.Top);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalRight(double width, double height)
		{

			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(width - 10.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width - 10.0, height);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Bottom, point2, Dock.Top);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForExternalTop(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(ExternalOffset1, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(ExternalOffset1, height);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(width - ExternalOffset2, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width - ExternalOffset2, height);
			System.Windows.Point p5 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point p6 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point bp = new System.Windows.Point(ExternalOffset1, 10.0);

			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, bp, Dock.Left, bp2, Dock.Right);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForExternalBottom(double width, double height)
		{
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(ExternalOffset1, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(ExternalOffset1, height);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(width - ExternalOffset2, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width - ExternalOffset2, height);
			System.Windows.Point p5 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height - 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point p6 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height - 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point bp = new System.Windows.Point(ExternalOffset1, height - 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point bp2 = new System.Windows.Point(width - ExternalOffset2, height - 10.0);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, bp, Dock.Left, bp2, Dock.Right);
		}

		private static Geometry GenerateGeometry(System.Windows.Point p11, System.Windows.Point p12, System.Windows.Point p21, System.Windows.Point p22, System.Windows.Point p31, System.Windows.Point p32, System.Windows.Point bp1, Dock orientation1, System.Windows.Point bp2, Dock orientation2)
		{
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure(p11, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p12, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure(p21, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p22, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			PathFigure pathFigure3 = new PathFigure(p31, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p32, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			PathFigure pathFigure4 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp1, orientation1);
			PathFigure pathFigure5 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp2, orientation2);
			return new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[5] { pathFigure, pathFigure2, pathFigure3, pathFigure4, pathFigure5 });
		}

		private static PathFigure GenerateArrowFigure(System.Windows.Point basePoint, Dock orientation)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point;
			System.Windows.Point point2;
			switch (orientation)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, 7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, 7.0);
				break;
			default:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, -7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, -7.0);
				break;
			}
			return new PathFigure(basePoint, new PathSegment[2]
			{
				new LineSegment(point, isStroked: true),
				new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: true);
		}
	}

namespace AspenTech.AspenPlus.MMForms.Blocks.Reactor.Rcstr.Converters
{
	internal class GeometryVariableValueConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private readonly string _fullFormat;

		private readonly string _displayedFormat;

		private readonly IFormatProvider _formatProvider;

		private readonly IFormatProvider _invariantProvider = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat;

		public GeometryVariableValueConverter(string fullFormat, string displayedFormat, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			_fullFormat = fullFormat;
			_displayedFormat = displayedFormat;
			_formatProvider = provider;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double? num = value as double?;
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return num.Value.ToString(_displayedFormat, _formatProvider);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double num)
			{
				return num.ToString(_fullFormat, _formatProvider);
			}
			string text = value as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, _formatProvider, out var result))
			{
				return result.ToString(_fullFormat, _formatProvider);
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, _invariantProvider, out result))
			{
				return result.ToString(_fullFormat, _formatProvider);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SmallValueToZeroConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		[DefaultValue(1E-12)]
		public double ConvertToZeroThreshold { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(value);
				if (num.HasValue && Math.Abs(num.Value) < Math.Abs(ConvertToZeroThreshold))
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (num == 1E+35)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
}
